caseName: Central States Electric Co. v. City of Muscatine
caseNameFull: Central States Electric Co. v. City of Muscatine

opinions.text: Ordered that the mandate be recalled and that the judgment and mandate of this court be amended so &s to provide that the costs of Central States Electric Company be paid from the $25,708.54 which was separated from the fund paid into the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit by the Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America, rather than by the City of Muscatine, Iowa.
